summary: Pair 3 (Congruent Faces) clears the strict bar with all categories at 4. Battista (2007) van Hiele L1->L2 transition cited in expanded_walkthrough.rationale; three diagnostic-branched recovery_moves (A: same-shape/different-size drop-back, B: rotation-doesn't-change-congruence, C: forced articulation frame). Puppets explicitly OPTIONAL with substitutions named, plus a NO-MATERIALS hand-shape path in differentiation.for_movement_learners. Tig's congruent refrain 'SAME SHAPE, SAME SIZE - that's CONGRUENT!' anchors hook and exit_routine (chanted 3x). Worksheet Parts 1-3 each map to a named success criterion and Part 3 deliberately varies to a justification/transfer task. Mathematical authenticity is precise: congruent defined as both-size-AND-shape, tested by overlap, with cube/rectangular-prism face examples.
